metadata.title: MoodNight
metadata.description: A quiet stage for dark poetry

door.title: The door is shut
door.line: Past this threshold go only those the candles already know.

forbidden.title: Not your threshold
forbidden.line: Your candle burns, but another key keeps this gate.

signIn.subtitle: Name yourself — and the candles will know you.

home.title: MoodNight
home.tagline: A free home for Ukrainian poetry — where the dark meets candlelight, and every word becomes a fire in the ashes of the night.

welcome.line: Your candle burns again. The night is listening.
welcome.since: In the book of shadows since {date, date, long}

feed.title: Fires of the night readings
feed.line: Voices that broke through the dark. Keep going down — it is still burning there.
feed.loading: The night is turning the pages
feed.emptyLine: The night is quiet: no poem has been carried here yet. Someone's will be the first.

poems.title: Poems
poems.line: This is where you will write new work and keep the written in order — drafts, poems sent to the queue, poems published.

compose.title: A new poem
compose.line: Light your candle and write. The lines fall exactly where you put them — the night reflows nothing.
compose.poemTitlePlaceholder: e.g., A shadow over the field
compose.subtitle: Subtitle
compose.bodyPlaceholder:
A shadow lay over the field,
and the wind fell still.
compose.bodyHint: Every line break is yours. We reflow nothing and align nothing.

users.title: Names
users.line: This is everyone whose candle burns: who is given a key, and whose candle is dimmed.
users.empty: No candle has been lit yet
users.emptyLine: Everyone whose candle burns will appear here.
